sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_theme"><sp_theme action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css_variables>/* ============================================================
   FeedNow · Fig & Apricot — Service Portal THEME VARIABLES
   Paste into: Service Portal > Themes > [FeedNow] > "CSS variables"
   These override the portal's built-in Bootstrap variables.
   ============================================================ */

/* ---- Palette ---- */
$fn-fig:          #3A1B2A;   /* header, dark panels */
$fn-fig-light:    #6A3D52;   /* logo ring track, nav hover */
$fn-apricot:      #A8521C;   /* primary buttons, links */
$fn-apricot-dark: #8C4415;   /* button hover */
$fn-apricot-light:#E58A3A;   /* accents, urgent bars (not for text) */
$fn-saffron:      #F2A93B;   /* active nav, "Post surplus" button */
$fn-ink:          #2E1620;   /* body text */
$fn-cream:        #F7EFE6;   /* page background */
$fn-card:         #FFFAF4;   /* cards, panels */
$fn-line:         #EBDCCB;   /* borders, dividers */
$fn-muted:        #6B4E4A;   /* secondary text */

/* ---- Bootstrap / Service Portal overrides ---- */
$brand-primary:   $fn-apricot;
$brand-success:   #6A4405;
$brand-info:      $fn-fig-light;
$brand-warning:   #8A4B05;
$brand-danger:    #8A3E0C;

$body-bg:          $fn-cream;
$text-color:       $fn-ink;
$text-muted:       $fn-muted;
$link-color:       $fn-apricot;
$link-hover-color: $fn-apricot-dark;

$font-family-sans-serif: 'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
$headings-font-family:   'Bricolage Grotesque', 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
$headings-font-weight:   700;
$headings-color:         $fn-ink;
$font-size-base:         16px;

$border-radius-base:  10px;
$border-radius-large: 14px;
$border-radius-small: 8px;

/* Header (Service Portal uses the inverse navbar) */
$navbar-inverse-bg:                $fn-fig;
$navbar-inverse-border:            $fn-fig;
$navbar-inverse-color:             #EADBE0;
$navbar-inverse-link-color:        #EADBE0;
$navbar-inverse-link-hover-color:  #FFFFFF;
$navbar-inverse-link-hover-bg:     $fn-fig-light;
$navbar-inverse-link-active-color: $fn-ink;
$navbar-inverse-link-active-bg:    $fn-saffron;
$navbar-inverse-brand-color:       $fn-cream;

/* Buttons */
$btn-primary-bg:     $fn-apricot;
$btn-primary-border: $fn-apricot;
$btn-primary-color:  #FFFFFF;
$btn-default-bg:     $fn-card;
$btn-default-border: $fn-apricot;
$btn-default-color:  $fn-apricot;

/* Panels & inputs */
$panel-bg:                 $fn-card;
$panel-default-border:     $fn-line;
$panel-default-heading-bg: $fn-card;
$input-border:             #D8C6B4;
$input-border-focus:       $fn-apricot;
$input-border-radius:      10px;
$list-group-bg:            $fn-card;
$list-group-border:        $fn-line;

</css_variables><footer/><footer_fixed>false</footer_fixed><header display_value="Stock Header">bf5ec2f2cb10120000f8d856634c9c0c</header><icon/><logo/><logo_alt_text/><matching_now_experience_theme/><name>FeedNow</name><navbar_fixed>false</navbar_fixed><sys_class_name>sp_theme</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Brittany</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-18 15:46:07</sys_created_on><sys_id>92f13cc9a58813107f4483acc6c6a172</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>FeedNow</sys_name><sys_package display_value="FeedNow " source="x_1234_feednow">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FeedNow ">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_theme_92f13cc9a58813107f4483acc6c6a172</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Brittany</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 13:56:01</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_theme><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=92f13cc9a58813107f4483acc6c6a172"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_css"><sp_css action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><css>/* ============================================================
   FeedNow Â· Fig & Apricot â€” Service Portal STYLESHEET
   Create via sp_css.list > New (name: feednow-theme),
   then add to your theme: Themes > [FeedNow] > CSS Includes > New.
   Load fonts with a separate CSS Include (Source: URL) â€” see notes.
   ============================================================ */

:root {
  --fn-fig: #3A1B2A;
  --fn-fig-light: #6A3D52;
  --fn-apricot: #A8521C;
  --fn-apricot-dark: #8C4415;
  --fn-apricot-light: #E58A3A;
  --fn-saffron: #F2A93B;
  --fn-ink: #2E1620;
  --fn-cream: #F7EFE6;
  --fn-card: #FFFAF4;
  --fn-line: #EBDCCB;
  --fn-muted: #6B4E4A;

  /* status pills */
  --fn-hot-bg: #FBE1C9;   --fn-hot-text: #8A3E0C;   /* urgent / breach */
  --fn-ok-bg: #F6E7C6;    --fn-ok-text: #6A4405;    /* open / claimed */
  --fn-warn-bg: #FCEBCB;  --fn-warn-text: #8A4B05;  /* SLA warning */
}

/* ---------- Base ---------- */
body {
  background: var(--fn-cream);
  color: var(--fn-ink);
  font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
}
h1, h2, h3, h4, .fn-display {
  font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  color: var(--fn-ink);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
a { color: var(--fn-apricot); }
a:hover, a:focus { color: var(--fn-apricot-dark); }

/* ---------- Header ---------- */
.navbar, .navbar-inverse {
  background: var(--fn-fig);
  border: 0;
}
.navbar .navbar-brand {
  font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 21px;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: var(--fn-cream);
}

/* stop the header from clipping the FeedNow title */
.navbar-header,
.navbar-brand,
.navbar-brand * {
  width: auto !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  text-overflow: clip !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}
.navbar-brand { padding-left: 20px !important; padding-right: 24px !important; }
.navbar .navbar-brand .fn-now { color: var(--fn-saffron); } /* wrap "Now" in <span class="fn-now"> */
.navbar-inverse .navbar-nav > li > a {
  color: #EADBE0;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.navbar-inverse .navbar-nav > li > a:hover { background: var(--fn-fig-light); color: #FFFFFF; }
.navbar-inverse .navbar-nav > .active > a,
.navbar-inverse .navbar-nav > .active > a:hover {
  background: var(--fn-saffron);
  color: var(--fn-ink);
}

/* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
.btn { border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 700; min-height: 44px; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--fn-apricot); border-color: var(--fn-apricot); color: #FFFFFF; }
.btn-primary:hover, .btn-primary:focus { background: var(--fn-apricot-dark); border-color: var(--fn-apricot-dark); color: #FFFFFF; }
.btn-default { background: var(--fn-card); border-color: var(--fn-apricot); color: var(--fn-apricot); }
.btn-default:hover { background: var(--fn-hot-bg); }
.btn-fn-post {               /* "Post surplus food" call to action */
  background: var(--fn-saffron);
  border-color: var(--fn-saffron);
  color: var(--fn-ink);
}
.btn-fn-post:hover { background: #E0962A; border-color: #E0962A; color: var(--fn-ink); }

/* ---------- Cards / panels ---------- */
.panel, .fn-card {
  background: var(--fn-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.panel-heading { background: transparent; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fn-line); }
.fn-card { padding: 20px; }
.fn-card-dark {
  background: var(--fn-fig);
  color: var(--fn-cream);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 20px;
}
.text-muted, .fn-muted { color: var(--fn-muted); }

/* ---------- Status pills (listing timers, SLA states) ---------- */
.fn-pill {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.fn-pill-urgent  { background: var(--fn-hot-bg);  color: var(--fn-hot-text); }
.fn-pill-open    { background: var(--fn-ok-bg);   color: var(--fn-ok-text); }
.fn-pill-warning { background: var(--fn-warn-bg); color: var(--fn-warn-text); }

/* Filter chips */
.fn-chip {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--fn-card);
  border: 1px solid var(--fn-line);
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--fn-ink);
}
.fn-chip.active { background: var(--fn-ink); color: var(--fn-card); border-color: var(--fn-ink); }

/* Countdown bar */
.fn-bar { height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--fn-line); overflow: hidden; }
.fn-bar > span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--fn-apricot); }
.fn-bar.urgent > span { background: var(--fn-apricot-light); }

/* ---------- Forms ---------- */
.form-control {
  min-height: 44px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border-color: #D8C6B4;
  background: #FFFFFF;
  color: var(--fn-ink);
}
.form-control:focus {
  border-color: var(--fn-apricot);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(168, 82, 28, 0.2);
}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
.fn-footer { background: var(--fn-fig); color: var(--fn-cream); padding: 24px 0; }

/* let the FeedNow title fit */
.navbar-brand,
.navbar-header .navbar-brand {
  width: auto !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  white-space: nowrap;
  padding-right: 24px;
}

/* hide the Guided Tours link in the header */
.navbar .gtd-dropdown-container,
#tour-dropdown {
  display: none !important;
}</css><name>feednow-theme</name><sys_class_name>sp_css</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Brittany</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-18 15:48:51</sys_created_on><sys_id>2ec4f441a5c813107f4483acc6c6a161</sys_id><sys_mod_count>4</sys_mod_count><sys_name>feednow-theme</sys_name><sys_package display_value="FeedNow " source="x_1234_feednow">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FeedNow ">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_css_2ec4f441a5c813107f4483acc6c6a161</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Brittany</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 14:04:10</sys_updated_on><turn_off_scss_compilation>false</turn_off_scss_compilation></sp_css></record_update>

customc/* FeedNow · Open listings widget — paste into the CSS - SCSS pane. Colors come from the feednow-theme stylesheet (fn-card, fn-pill, fn-bar, fn-chip, buttons). */ .fn-listings { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 32px 16px 48px; } .fn-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 24px; } .fn-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; color: #A8521C; } .fn-title { margin: 0; <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Request Food">b84c13fdbd0c13107f4415c9e4eed590</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:1d4c1b35bd4c13107f4415c9e4eed57d</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Validate Needed by date</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[
function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }

    var selectedTime = getDateFromFormat(
        newValue,
        g_user_date_time_format
    );

    if (selectedTime == 0) {
        g_form.showFieldMsg(
            'needed_by_date',
            'Please enter a valid pickup date and time.',
            'error'
        );
        return;
    }

    var now = new Date().getTime();

    if (selectedTime < now) {
        g_form.clearValue('needed_by_date');
        g_form.showFieldMsg(
            'needed_by_date',
            'Needed by date and time must be now or in the future.',
            'error'
        );
    } else {
        g_form.hideFieldMsg('needed_by_date', true);
    }
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Anjali</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-21 18:34:49</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>0507f04ebd4853107f4415c9e4eed5f1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Validate Needed by date</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="FeedNow " source="x_1234_feednow">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FeedNow ">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_0507f04ebd4853107f4415c9e4eed5f1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Anjali</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-21 19:32:54</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

    var selected = g_form.getValue('u_needed_by');

    if (!selected)
        return true;

    var selectedDate = new GlideDateTime(selected);
    var currentDate = new GlideDateTime();

    if (selectedDate.before(currentDate)) {

        g_form.addErrorMessage(
            'Please select a future date and time.'
        );

        return false;
    }

    return true;
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Moumita</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-21 21:46:36</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>a0a98d4ebd0c53107f4415c9e4eed5d9</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Pickup by</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="FeedNow " source="x_1234_feednow">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FeedNow ">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_a0a98d4ebd0c53107f4415c9e4eed5d9</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Moumita</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-21 21:46:36</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onSubmit</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>true</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>true</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Post Food">88272d4ebd0093107f4415c9e4eed5f1</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:2827a58ebd0093107f4415c9e4eed5d5</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Validate Pickup by</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {

    if (isLoading || !newValue)
        return;

    var selectedDate = new Date(newValue);
    var currentDate = new Date();

    if (selectedDate < currentDate) {

        g_form.showFieldMsg(
            'pickup_by',
            'Pickup date cannot be in the past',
            'error'
        );

Urgent requests run on a shorter clock and alert the coordinator right away.</p><p class=\"fn-paper-body\">Once submitted, FeedNow looks for an available listing of the same food type. <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sp_page"><sp_page action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><category>custom</category><css>
/* =========================================================
   FEEDNOW — HOMEPAGE STYLES
   Warm cream, peach, orange, gold and burgundy palette
   ========================================================= */


/* 1. HERO AND PAGE SPACING */

main.body.padding-top {
  padding-top: 0;
}

.fn-stats-layout {
  padding-top: 24px;
}


/* 2. THREE-COLUMN DASHBOARD LAYOUT */

@media (min-width: 992px) {

  .fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid > sp-page-row > .row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  /* Left column: statistics */
  .fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid > sp-page-row > .row > .col-md-3:first-child {
    flex: 0 0 220px;
    width: 220px;
    max-width: 220px;
    padding-left: 24px;
  }

  /* Centre column: action tiles */
  .fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid > sp-page-row > .row > .col-md-6 {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    width: auto;
  }

  .fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid > sp-page-row > .row > .col-md-6 .row {
    max-width: 760px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  /* Right column: knowledge article */
  .fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid > sp-page-row > .row > .col-md-3:last-child {
    flex: 0 0 340px;
    width: 340px;
    max-width: 340px;
    padding-right: 24px;
  }
}


/* 3. STATISTICS TILES — TRANSLUCENT CREAM */

.fn-stats-layout .report-widget-wrap {
  background: rgba(255, 250, 244, 0.72) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(3px);

  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
  border-left: 4px solid #F2A93B;
  border-radius: 12px;

  box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(58, 27, 42, 0.14);

  padding: 14px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  text-align: left;

  pointer-events: none;
  cursor: default;
}

.fn-stats-layout .report-widget-title {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  margin: 0 0 2px;
  color: #6B4E4A;
}

.fn-stats-layout .report-widget-wrap h1,
.fn-stats-layout .report-widget-wrap h3,
.fn-stats-layout .report-widget-wrap .single-score {
  color: #2E1620;
}


/* 4. ACTION TILES — TRANSLUCENT WHITE */

.fn-stats-layout .iconlink a.top_icon {
  display: block;

  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.76) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(3px);

  border: 1px solid rgba(62, 27, 47, 0.12);
  border-radius: 16px;

  box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(62, 27, 47, 0.10);

  padding: 28px 20px 24px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;

  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;

  transition:
    transform 0.15s ease,
    box-shadow 0.15s ease,
    border-color 0.15s ease;
}

.fn-stats-layout .iconlink a.top_icon:hover,
.fn-stats-layout .iconlink a.top_icon:focus {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(62, 27, 47, 0.18);
  border-color: #F2A93B;
  text-decoration: none;
}


/* 5. ACTION TILE TEXT AND ICONS */

.fn-stats-layout .iconlink a.top_icon h2 {
  color: #2E1620;
}

.fn-stats-layout .iconlink a.top_icon .fa {
  color: #A8521C;
}


/* 6. MY MATCHES — KEEP THE BURGUNDY FEATURE BAR */

.fn-stats-layout .col-md-12 .iconlink a.top_icon {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 20px;

  padding: 20px 24px;

  background: #3A1B2A !important;
  border-color: #3A1B2A;
}

.fn-stats-layout .col-md-12 .iconlink a.top_icon .fa {
  font-size: 32px !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  color: #F2A93B !important;
}

.fn-stats-layout .col-md-12 .iconlink a.top_icon h2 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #F7EFE6;
  font-size: 22px;
}

.fn-stats-layout .col-md-12 .iconlink a.top_icon .text-muted {
  color: #EADBE0 !important;
  margin-left: 8px;
}

.fn-stats-layout .col-md-12 .iconlink a.top_icon:hover {
  background: #6A3D52 !important;
  border-color: #F2A93B;
}


/* 7. KNOWLEDGE ARTICLE — TRANSLUCENT PAPER */

.fn-paper {
  background: rgba(255, 250, 244, 0.82);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
  backdrop-filter: blur(3px);

  border: 1px solid rgba(235, 220, 203, 0.85);
  border-top: 4px double #3A1B2A;

  padding: 20px 22px 18px;

  font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif;
  color: #2E1620;
}

.fn-paper-kicker {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #6B4E4A;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.fn-paper-head {
  font-family: Georgia, serif;
  font-size: 24px;
  line-height: 1.15;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  color: #2E1620;
}

.fn-paper-date {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #6B4E4A;

  border-bottom: 1px solid #EBDCCB;
  padding-bottom: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.fn-paper-body {
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  text-align: justify;
}

.fn-dropcap {
  float: left;
  font-size: 44px;
  line-height: 36px;
  padding: 4px 6px 0 0;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #A8521C;
}

.fn-paper-link {
  font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #A8521C;
}



/* 8. FEEDNOW BACKGROUND — EXTRA FADED */

body {
  background-color: #FFF8F0 !important;
  background-image: none !important;
}

/* Keep the artwork behind the page content */
body #page,
body .sp-page-root {
  background-color: transparent !important;
  background-image: none !important;
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
}

/* Faded artwork layer */
body .sp-page-root::before {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;

  background-image:
    linear-gradient(
      rgba(255, 248, 240, 0.58),
      rgba(255, 248, 240, 0.58)
    ),
    url('https://sya-oct-1140-0004.lab.service-now.com/x_1234_feednow.bg_image_new.png');

  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center top;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
}



/* 9. KEEP THE DASHBOARD CONTAINERS TRANSPARENT */

.fn-stats-layout,
.fn-stats-layout > .container-fluid {
  background-color: transparent !important;
}


/* 10. RESPONSIVE ADJUSTMENTS */

@media (max-width: 991px) {

  .fn-stats-layout {
    padding-top: 16px;
  }

  .fn-stats-layout .iconlink a.top_icon {
    padding: 22px 16px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .fn-stats-layout .col-md-12 .iconlink a.top_icon {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 18px;
  }

  .fn-paper {
    padding: 16px;
  }
}
</css><draft>false</draft><dynamic_title_structure/><human_readable_url_structure/><id>fn_index</id><internal>false</internal><omit_watcher>false</omit_watcher><public>false</public><roles/><seo_script/><short_description/><sys_class_name>sp_page</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Brittany</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-21 19:52:40</sys_created_on><sys_id>ab89c94ebd0c53107f4415c9e4eed5ae</sys_id><sys_mod_count>16</sys_mod_count><sys_name>fn_index</sys_name><sys_package display_value="FeedNow " source="x_1234_feednow">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FeedNow ">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sp_page_ab89c94ebd0c53107f4415c9e4eed5ae</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Harish</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-26 18:40:35</sys_updated_on><title>Home</title><use_seo_script>false</use_seo_script></sp_page><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=ab89c94ebd0c53107f4415c9e4eed5ae"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sn_aia_version"><sn_aia_version action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><condition/><instructions>Step 1 — Understand the request Identify whether the user needs help posting surplus food, requesting food, viewing available listings, checking matches, or understanding a request status. Ask a brief clarifying question when necessary.
Step 2 — Determine the appropriate guidance Select the relevant FeedNow feature and provide the correct navigation instructions for the user's task.
Step 3 — Retrieve verified information If the user asks about a specific listing, request, or match, use an available authorised ServiceNow tool to retrieve the relevant records. Apply the user's existing access permissions and use only the information needed to answer.
Step 4 — Explain the result Summarise the retrieved information clearly. Explain request statuses only when supported by the actual record or verified application configuration. Never invent availability, quantities, expiry dates, or match details.
Step 5 — Handle unavailable information safely If no authorised tool is available, the record cannot be accessed, or the information cannot be verified, explain the limitation and direct the user to the appropriate FeedNow page.
Step 6 — Protect records and personal information Do not create, update, or delete records unless an explicitly configured and authorised tool allows the action. Obtain any required confirmation before performing an action, and report success only after it is confirmed.
Step 7 — Close with a useful next step Provide one relevant next action, such as opening available listings, submitting a request, viewing My Requests, or checking My Matches.</instructions><state>published</state><sys_class_name>sn_aia_version</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Harish</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-26 19:09:55</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>cebf2623a98053107f448661a154e832</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>V1</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="FeedNow " source="x_1234_feednow">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FeedNow ">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sn_aia_version_cebf2623a98053107f448661a154e832</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Harish</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-26 19:09:55</sys_updated_on><target_id>1cee2aa7a94053107f448661a154e80d</target_id><target_table>sn_aia_agent</target_table><version_name>V1</version_name><version_number>1</version_number></sn_aia_version></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sn_aia_agent"><sn_aia_agent action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><advanced_mode>false</advanced_mode><agent_type>internal</agent_type><applicability_script><![CDATA[/** * Function to process inputs related to ServiceNow change request operations * * @param {Object} inputs - The input parameters object * @param {string} inputs.objective - The purpose or goal of the operation * @param {string} inputs.execution_plan_id - Unique identifier for the execution plan * @param {Object} inputs.context - Context information about the ServiceNow change request * @param {string} inputs.context.url - The URL of the change request in Service Operations Workspace * @param {string} inputs.context.table - The ServiceNow table name (e.g., 'change_request') * @param {string} inputs.context.record_sys_id - The sys ID of the record * @param {string} inputs.context.route - The route type (e.g., 'record') * @param {string} inputs.context.additional_context - Additional contextual information in JSON format * @param {string} inputs.context.experience - The UI experience name (e.g., 'Service Operations Workspace') * @param {string} inputs.context.number - The request number * @param {string} inputs.context.portal - The portal ID * @param {string} inputs.context.device_type - The device type from which the experience is accessed, e.g.'mweb' * @param {string} inputs.context.deployment_id - The unique identifier for the assistant deployment * @param {string} inputs.context.assistant_type - The type of assistant, e.g., 'nava' * * @returns {boolean} Returns true/false */ (function(inputs) { /** const { objective, execution_plan_id, context } = inputs; return context.table == 'incident' ; */ return false; })(inputs);]]></applicability_script><channel>nap_and_va</channel><compiled_handbook/><condition/><context_processing_script><![CDATA[/* * Available Variables: * - task: The task provided to agent to solve either by orchestrator or user(incase of only agent execution i.e agent is invoked as seperate entity instead from a workflow). * - user_utterance: The user utterance provided. and task = user_utterance in case of individual agent execution. * - agent_id: The agent id. * - context: An object that carries additional contextual information for the agent. * It always includes a "pageContext" and may include a "triggerContext", * depending on how and from where the agent is invoked. * * Behavior by invocation type: * --------------------------------- * - When invoked via the startAiAgentConversation API: * If a "contextMemory" parameter is provided in the API request, * it will be available here as the "triggerContext". * The "pageContext" is always present in this call, regardless * of whether the agent is executed individually or as part of a use case. * Example: * { * pageContext: { ... }, * triggerContext: { ... } // Derived from contextMemory (if passed) * } * * - When invoked as part of a use case or workflow: * The "pageContext" and "triggerContext" objects available here * may have been *modified* by the use case’s context processing script. * This means the use case may alter, extend, or overwrite values * from the original "pageContext" or "triggerContext" * before the context reaches the agent. * If the use case was originally triggered via the API, * the initial "triggerContext" is still derived from the * "contextMemory" parameter, but its contents may have been updated * by the use case logic. * * - When executed directly (standalone agent execution): * The "pageContext" will always be present (default or empty), * and the "triggerContext" will only be populated if explicitly * passed through the API call. * Return an modified context like: { pageContext : {},triggerContext:{} } */ (function(task, user_utterance, agent_id, context) { return { pageContext : context?.pageContext, triggerContext : context?.triggerContext }; })(task,user_utterance, agent_id, context);]]></context_processing_script><description>Helps food donors and recipient organisations use FeedNow, understand food listings and request statuses, and reduce food waste through safe, accurate, role-aware guidance.</description><extends/><extension_configuration/><external_agent_configuration/><inputs>""</inputs><instructions>Step 1 — Understand the request Identify whether the user needs help posting surplus food, requesting food, viewing available listings, checking matches, or understanding a request status. Ask a brief clarifying question when necessary.
Step 2 — Determine the appropriate guidance Select the relevant FeedNow feature and provide the correct navigation instructions for the user's task.
Step 3 — Retrieve verified information If the user asks about a specific listing, request, or match, use an available authorised ServiceNow tool to retrieve the relevant records. Apply the user's existing access permissions and use only the information needed to answer.
Step 4 — Explain the result Summarise the retrieved information clearly. Explain request statuses only when supported by the actual record or verified application configuration. Never invent availability, quantities, expiry dates, or match details.
Step 5 — Handle unavailable information safely If no authorised tool is available, the record cannot be accessed, or the information cannot be verified, explain the limitation and direct the user to the appropriate FeedNow page.
Step 6 — Protect records and personal information Do not create, update, or delete records unless an explicitly configured and authorised tool allows the action. Obtain any required confirmation before performing an action, and report success only after it is confirmed.
Step 7 — Close with a useful next step Provide one relevant next action, such as opening available listings, submitting a request, viewing My Requests, or checking My Matches.</instructions><internal_name>global.x_1234_feednow.FeedNow Assistant</internal_name><name>FeedNow Assistant</name><outputs>""</outputs><parent/><post_processing_message>I've finished checking. Here's what I found.</post_processing_message><processing_message>Checking FeedNow information for you...</processing_message><proficiency>- FeedNow Assistant is proficient in providing concise, friendly, and step-by-step guidance to food donors and recipient organisations, helping them navigate the FeedNow ServiceNow application, understand its features, and safely access verified information about surplus food, food listings, requests, and matches, all while respecting the user's role and access permissions. - FeedNow Assistant is capable of identifying the user's specific needs (posting surplus food, requesting food, viewing listings, checking matches, or understanding request status) and providing targeted, step-by-step navigation instructions for the relevant FeedNow features. - FeedNow Assistant is capable of retrieving and summarising verified information about specific food listings, requests, or matches using authorised ServiceNow tools, strictly applying the user's access permissions and only using information necessary to answer the user's query. - FeedNow Assistant is proficient in summarising and explaining retrieved information about food listings, requests, or matches, including request statuses, only when supported by actual records or verified application configuration, ensuring users receive accurate and trustworthy answers. - FeedNow Assistant is capable of safely handling situations where information cannot be verified or accessed, by clearly explaining the limitation and directing users to the appropriate FeedNow page or feature for further assistance. - FeedNow Assistant is capable of protecting records and personal information by refraining from creating, updating, or deleting records unless an explicitly configured and authorised tool permits the action, and by obtaining any required user confirmation before performing such actions. - FeedNow Assistant is proficient in closing each interaction with a relevant next action, such as opening available listings, submitting a request, viewing My Requests, or checking My Matches, to ensure users are guided towards productive engagement with FeedNow.</proficiency><record_type>custom</record_type><required_translations/><research>false</research><role>You are FeedNow Assistant, a food rescue support agent for the FeedNow ServiceNow application.
Your responsibility is to help food donors and recipient organisations navigate FeedNow, understand its features, and safely access verified information about surplus food, food listings, requests, and matches.
Provide concise, friendly, step-by-step guidance. Respect the user's role and existing ServiceNow access permissions. Use authorised tools when available to retrieve record-specific information. Never fabricate food availability, quantities, expiry dates, matches, or request statuses. Do not claim to have completed an action unless an authorised tool confirms success. Do not create, update, or delete records unless an explicitly configured tool permits it and any required user confirmation has been obtained. If information cannot be verified, explain how the user can check it in FeedNow.</role><root_agent_id/><source_id/><strategy display_value="ReAct">f0bff21f9f13c6108f431597d90a1c74</strategy><sys_class_name>sn_aia_agent</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>Harish</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-26 19:09:55</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_id>1cee2aa7a94053107f448661a154e80d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>FeedNow Assistant</sys_name><sys_package display_value="FeedNow " source="x_1234_feednow">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="FeedNow ">0a45b2d030cc13107f44e33af865b463</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sn_aia_agent_1cee2aa7a94053107f448661a154e80d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>Harish</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-26 19:54:24</sys_updated_on></sn_aia_agent></record_update>
